backgrounds: exclude bins overlapping any other known structure
empirical_null: For each flank/background, take the maximum absolute replicate log2 difference within each adaptive-context overlap group and each of WT, HNS_mut, FIS_mut; pool these group maxima as a descriptive repeat-noise reference. This is not a permutation test or formal p-value.
selection: An initial candidate must maintain direction and at least 0.25 log2 magnitude across all three flank widths and both background definitions; all four unpaired cross-condition contrasts must agree; and each sensitivity effect must exceed both its pooled within-repeat group-maximum 99th-percentile threshold and the largest observed within-repeat group maximum.
limitations: Only two biological replicates per condition.
Condition-internal replicate differences are one observed realization per structure; spatial groups are dependent despite overlap clustering.
The empirical null is a conservative descriptive noise benchmark, not formal family-wise error control or FDR.
The coordinate data and loci have been examined previously; this is retrospective robustness analysis.
